about: The pinned corpus of the reduced PR 21 evaluation (docs/cavr-m2-plan.md). Real PyPI releases (pinned, with every child pinned in the project's lockfile) and the 14 synthetic M2 demo wheels of tests/test_cavr_m2_wheels.py. Expected values were written from the code and from PyPI / OSV answers read on 2026-11-25, before the live run, and are not changed after it: a result that differs is reported as a mismatch. expected.rule null means the rule was not predicted (only the status is). No known-malicious package is listed: the attack set is local synthetic wheels only.
